name: perl-test-leaktrace
description: This skill facilitates the identification of memory leaks within Perl applications and modules.
overview: This skill facilitates the identification of memory leaks within Perl applications and modules. By wrapping specific blocks of code or entire test suites, it monitors the reference counts of Perl SVs (Scalar Values). It is essential for ensuring long-running processes remain stable and do not consume unbounded memory due to circular references or improper resource management.
